llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it only requires curl and a single API key to call portal.toolweb.in and its instructions match the stated IT risk-assessment purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the runtime requirements: the skill needs an API key and curl to call https://portal.toolweb.in/apis/security/it-risk-assessment. These are proportionate and expected for a hosted risk-assessment service.

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to collect user-provided maturity ratings and POST them (with X-API-Key) to the third-party API; it does not instruct reading local files, other env vars, or system secrets. Note: user inputs (which may include sensitive configuration details) will be transmitted to the external service — this is expected for the stated purpose but is a privacy consideration.

llm.guidance: This skill will send whatever assessment answers you provide to portal.toolweb.in using the TOOLWEB_API_KEY. Before enabling it: (1) confirm you trust ToolWeb and review their privacy/data-retention policy and terms of service; (2) avoid sending highly sensitive secrets or PII in assessment answers; (3) use a scoped or revocable API key if possible and rotate it after testing; (4) test with non-sensitive/sample data first to verify outputs; and (5) if you require on-prem or non-external processing, request an offline/self-hosted alternative from the vendor. If you want more assurance, ask the publisher for API docs showing what data is stored and how sessionIds are handled.
